history.summary: A freehold 2004 3BR at The Morning Glory (D19 Serangoon/Upper Serangoon) for $1.68M / $1,576 psf, with an eye-catching but unreliable 9.42%/yr URA rate built on only 5 transactions. PSF is ~7% above median and the MRT walk is poor (1.12km), so the headline appreciation should be heavily discounted.
history.rating_rationale: The 9.42%/yr URA CAGR is statistically meaningless on 5 txns — do not anchor on it. On fundamentals: freehold is a plus and $1.68M is a liquid 3BR quantum, but PSF $1,576 is ~7% above the $1,471 median (paying up), and 1.12km/14-min to NE12 Serangoon is a weak walk that caps rental and resale appeal. A boutique freehold near Serangoon hub is a fair-but-unexciting hold; nets to Neutral with the inflated rate discounted.
red_flags: 9.42%/yr URA rate rests on just 5 transactions — unreliable, discount heavily
Listed PSF ~7% above the $1,471 URA median
Poor transit — 1.12km / 14-min walk to NE12 Serangoon MRT
catalysts: Freehold tenure at a liquid $1.68M 3BR quantum
Proximity to Serangoon/NEX regional hub and NE-line catchment
